original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克德尔加杜角省叛乱分子被指杀害三人并绑架12人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据报，叛乱分子自周末以来在莫桑比克Muidumbe和Macomia地区发动一系列袭击，至少杀害三人并绑架12人。当地消息称，周二在Miangaleua附近有五人被掳走，在Chai有七人被掳走，叛乱分子要求每名人质支付5万梅蒂卡尔。事件引发Messalo河附近社区恐慌，并加剧对EN380公路沿线安全的担忧。

location.raw_text: Muidumbe and Macomia districts, near the Messalo River and along the EN380

key_facts.fact: 叛乱分子被指在Muidumbe和Macomia地区杀害至少三人并绑架12人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Insurgents have killed at least three people and abducted 12 others in a series of incursions across Muidumbe and Macomia districts since the weekend

key_facts.fact: 周二在Miangaleua附近有五人被掳走，在Chai有七人被掳走
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Five people were seized near Miangaleua and seven in Chai on Tuesday

key_facts.fact: 当地消息称叛乱分子要求每名人质支付5万梅蒂卡尔
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: local sources say the insurgents are demanding MZN50,000 for each hostage

key_facts.fact: 事件引发Messalo河附近社区恐慌并加剧对EN380公路沿线安全的担忧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: spreading fear among communities near the Messalo River and raising concerns about security along the EN380

uncertainties: 伤亡与绑架人数为据报数据，尚未获得独立确认
叛乱分子索要赎金的消息来自当地消息源，尚未证实
目前仅有一个来源（Zitamar News）报道，缺乏交叉验证
